title: Have / had / had
descriptionFa: عبارت‌های پرکاربرد با have، و have got و have to.

words.example: I have breakfast at seven every morning.
words.tipFa: بدون the: have breakfast، نه have the breakfast.

words.example: Let's have lunch together on Thursday.
In Iran, we usually have dinner quite late.
Let's have a party for Mina's birthday.
We have a meeting with the manager every Monday.
Do you want to have a game of chess?
words.tipFa: با of: have a game of tennis.

words.example: Let's have a drink after work.
words.tipFa: have a cup of tea / coffee هم رایجه.

words.example: The children have a bath every evening.
The water is warm. Let's have a swim!
Have a look at this photo of my new flat.
I've never tried skiing, but I'd like to have a go.
Have a good journey! Call us when you arrive.
Do you have a moment? I need your help.
Can I have a word with you after the lesson?
I need to have my hair cut before the wedding.
words.tipFa: یعنی یکی دیگه کوتاهش می‌کنه، نه خودت. have your hair cut, have her hair cut.

words.example: Sorry, I don't have time to talk now.
words.tipFa: don't have the time هم می‌گن.

words.example: We have got ten minutes before the train leaves.
words.tipFa: توی حرف زدن: I've got = I have. سؤال: Have you got a pen?

words.example: I have to get up at six tomorrow.
words.tipFa: تلفظ: «هَف تو». خودمونی‌ترش: I've got to.

words.example: When I was at school, I had to wear a uniform.
words.tipFa: گذشته بدون got: I had to، نه I had got to.
